LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_FlowerEnvoy.label: Flower Envoy
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_FlowerEnvoy.description: The foundation of Qinghe as the Flower Envoy: the lotus shield ever at her side, a trickle that soothes old wounds, and the flower gods' mercy watching over her final breath.\n\n—Starts with Flower Decree: Spring Flow and Lunar Mirror, plus the sword art: Illusory Reflection.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Jueying.label: Sword Dance
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Jueying.description: A sword art Qinghe grasped after training with her teacher Neiyu, turning bell tones into sword qi—combining the startling speed of Sword Form: Skyfall with Qinghe's own cutting art.\n\n—Unlocks the sword art: Finishing Sword: Falling Blossoms. Dash in the chosen direction; on hit, leap off the target and pursue. On landing, spend all Sword Pressure to unleash 7 powerful slashes; with less than 1 stack it still works, but slash count and power are greatly reduced.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Luoshenfu.label: Luoshui Rite
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Luoshenfu.description: Upon the Luo waters, the goddess bears witness.\n\n—Unlocks the passive: Luoshui Rite. If Qinghe already has a spouse, the two form a Luoshen contract, bringing peace to both hearts; until fate arrives, she waits in quiet hope.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_FlowerMandate1.label: Flower Mandate I
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_FlowerMandate2.label: Flower Mandate II
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_BlessingCharge1.label: Mercy I
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_BlessingCharge1.description: Flower-God Mercy can store 1 additional charge.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_BlessingCharge2.label: Mercy II
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_BlessingCharge2.description: Flower-God Mercy can store 1 additional charge.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_LotusShield.label: Lotus Shield
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_LotusShield.description: Qinghe is protected by the twelve flower gods and naturally generates a lotus shield (500 capacity, 15/s regen, down for 3s after breaking). A single hit against the shield never costs more than 20 energy; the excess is blocked.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_DivineBlessing.label: Flower-God Mercy
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_DivineBlessing.description: Triggers automatically against lethal or part-destroying damage: the hit is negated, all injuries are restored, and Qinghe briefly becomes invisible and invulnerable. Starts with 1 charge; grace nodes raise it to 3.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_Trickle.label: Trickle
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_Trickle.description: Qinghe slowly mends wounds over time, and gradually restores permanent injuries and missing body parts.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_FlowerDecree.label: Flower Decree
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_FlowerDecree.description: The charge resource used to cast Flower Mandates, recovering over time. Grace nodes raise the cap to 5.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_SwordPressure.label: Sword Pressure
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_SwordPressure.description: Built by melee hits while Sanhua is equipped; spent to empower Illusory Reflection and Finishing Sword: Falling Blossoms.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_Stillness.label: Stillness
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_Stillness.description: Meditation, reading, and sleep build Stillness. On quality-bearing work: while Stillness is not full, nothing is consumed and there is a chance to raise quality by 1; when full, all Stillness is consumed to raise quality by 2.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_DivineGrace.label: Flower-God Grace
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_DivineGrace.description: When Qinghe crafts a masterwork or legendary item, her grace level rises by 1 (max 24). Grace improves her base stats and automatically unlocks the nodes on the timeline below.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_QixiRitual.label: Qixi Rite
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trait_QixiRitual.description: Once per year, a Qixi rite can be held at the lotus pond. Participants may gain inspiration, and Qinghe receives a copy of "Lotus Rain Pavilion Artistry".
